notification.title: Keep Your Favorite Apps Alive ❤️
notification.contents: Heyy ❤️ I'm Cyberghost, the developer behind Cubic Music, The Cube & Narra. I love building these apps, and Cubic Music will always be free. If you'd like to help with servers, development and maintenance, any donation means a lot. Even $0.94 is appreciated ❤️ Thank you for being part of this journey!
